task:
Start Phase 13 on a new local branch based exactly on origin/main (currently merged Phase 12 cbbe814283cfe91034ba8315e0d6f32955d3f8bc): create and switch to feat/phase-13-gateway, then replace the metadata-only gateway transport checkpoint with a real bounded authenticated AIP-side TCP gateway. Keep AIP standalone: do not import BielOS, call Cloudflare, read credentials/.env, or implement a public relay. Preserve the existing gateway.rs Rust/SQLite authority and its Owner/safe-mode/temporary-chat/integrity/idempotency/replay/audit/revocation rules.

Implement a new gateway transport core (prefer a small gateway_transport.rs module; do not weaken or break companion_transport.rs) with protocol `aip-gateway-v1`, strict serde frame schema with deny_unknown_fields, deterministic canonical fields, lower-case HMAC-SHA256 MAC, constant-time verification, bounded newline-delimited frames <=16 KiB and payload <=8 KiB, strict field validation, private bind policy (localhost by default; RFC1918 only with explicit confirmation), explicit stop that closes all connections, in-memory one-time pairing secret/rotation/revocation, per client/session monotonic counter + nonce replay protection surviving reconnect, signed bounded responses, typed bounded error payloads, and no secret logging/persistence. Expose testable encode/decode/sign helpers and deterministic loopback/replay/concurrency/bounds/rotation/stop tests.

Integrate the gateway into Tauri AppState with a separate GatewayTransportState and commands `start_gateway_transport`, `stop_gateway_transport`, and `get_gateway_transport_status`. Start must require explicit Owner confirmation, reject temporary chat, safe mode, unknown/non-Owner agent, invalid bind policy, and already-invalid state; default to 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port. Return the endpoint and pairing code only from the successful start result; status must redact secrets. Pairing is in memory only. The handler must route authenticated frames to existing gateway DB operations for protocol/accounts/transfers/transfer_prepare/transfer_approve/sessions/session_connect/session_reconnect/recoveries/recovery_request/recovery_approve/audit/revocations/session_revoke/transfer_revoke, with strict payload parsing, bounded JSON responses, typed errors, Owner identity in every mutating payload, and database authority remaining fail-closed. Add the module to lib.rs, initialize state, register commands, and ensure normal app startup/teardown stops the listener.

Add a Rust temporary-database localhost integration test that starts the actual gateway listener, performs a signed protocol/read/transfer prepare+approve/session round trip using the fixture Owner, proves wrong-MAC/replay/old-counter/unknown-field/temporary/safe-mode/revocation failures, verifies a signed error response and connection closure after stop, and does not use BielOS or external network. Add/update strict serde tests as needed. Keep all existing tests passing. Run cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check, cargo check --locked, cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked, and git diff --check. Commit the implementation in focused commits (transport core, Tauri/DB integration, tests) with clean status. Do not edit docs or React in this task; those are a follow-up. Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents or alternate backend.
constraints: Use only configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents or alternate backend.
AIP must remain standalone; no BielOS imports, Cloudflare credentials, public listener, relay, telemetry, or raw-secret logging/persistence.
Mutating gateway requests must retain Owner, safe-mode, temporary-chat, integrity, idempotency, replay, audit, revocation and bounded-state checks in Rust/SQLite.
Do not modify Android/Phase 12 behavior or docs/React in this task.
